name.zh: 墙面指端接触掌根抬起诊断

purpose.zh: 检查手指撑墙时掌根抬起的控制
purpose.en: Check how well you control lifting the palm heel with fingertips on the wall.

text.zh: 指尖贴墙不动，慢慢抬起掌根
text.en: Keep your fingertips on the wall and slowly lift the heel of your palm

text.zh: 面向墙站稳，手臂放松，不耸肩
text.en: Stand facing the wall, arm relaxed, shoulders down.

text.zh: 抬到能控制的高度停住，再慢慢放回
text.en: Pause at the height you can control, then lower slowly.

commonErrors.zh: 指尖在墙上滑动或离开墙面
commonErrors.en: Letting the fingertips slide or leave the wall.

commonErrors.zh: 用身体前倾代替手腕发力
commonErrors.en: Leaning the body in instead of moving the wrist.

cautions.zh: 手腕或手指疼痛时减小幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Reduce the range if your wrist or fingers hurt, and stop if the pain continues.
